_purpose: One row per source-derived count stated in prose somewhere in this repository. Each row names WHERE the claim is written (claim_file + a pattern, never a line number — line numbers drift exactly the way the prose does, IMP-0150's own citation is the proof) and HOW to recompute the true value (derive). Adding a newly discovered stale count is a NEW ROW here, never a change to scripts/verify-derived-counts.py.
_residual: Only claims registered here are checked. A number in a sentence is not distinguishable from any other number, so an unregistered prose count stays unchecked and there is no mechanical way to find one — see the module docstring in verify-derived-counts.py.

claims.description: config/revitalise-grant-automation-pipeline.yml describes the DEV and TST post-deploy seed-settings steps as seeding 'the eleven rev_setting rows'. Truth is the length of dataverse.settingRows in every deployment-settings file that carries one (dev-scoring, test, prd) — those three must also agree with each other.

The trustee-portal build session handover states REV_TrusteeRestricted grants read access to 'all 39 secured columns'. Truth is the number of FieldPermission entries in FieldSecurityProfiles.xml, which must equal the number of IsSecured=1 columns across every Entity.xml (both counted properly — see verify-derived-counts.py's docstring on why grep -c '<FieldPermission' is the wrong tool).

Improvement review 5 states twice ('grants read on all 39 secured columns'; 'standing between the trustee role and 39 secured columns') that the profile secures 39 columns. Same truth as the handover claim above.
The Dev Summary's security-controls table asserts the coverage test's exact-count check as '(39, not 40 or more)'. Same truth as the handover claim above.

Dev Summary section 9's verification table recorded a LIVE fieldpermissions query returning 39 on 2026-08-21, which was an exact match to source that day. Repointed 2026-08-22: that figure is a dated observation and correcting it to today's number would assert a result the query never produced, so the row now checks the sentence's live half ('source is N today') and the historical half is left standing as history.

The REV Trustee role file's own header documents the non-membership control as covering N secured columns. Same truth as the handover claim above. Pattern made tilde-optional 2026-08-22: the header said '~39' and now states the exact derived figure, and a pattern that only matched the approximate form became a REGISTRY DEFECT the moment the number was corrected -- the gate objecting to its own fix.

The Dev Summary narrates the solution's pre-existing 'not defined in customizations' pack warnings as four; the packer emits eight (one EntityRelationship, three EnvironmentVariableDefinition, three Type='10371' GenericComponent -- plus the header line itself is not a warning). Truth is derived from the captured packer output in the Dev Summary's own build transcript: the count of indented "Type='...'" lines directly under the 'Following root components are not defined in customizations:' header. Third instance of hand-maintained-count-drifts-from-source, and the first that cost a registry row instead of a script.

derive.command: awk '/Following root components are not defined in customizations:/{f=1;next} f&&/^ *Type=/{n++;next} f&&!/^ *Type=/{f=0} END{print n+0}' docs/development/revitalise-grant-automation-dev-summary.md
